@: The clip player (web/js/player.js): the video, its header title, the overlay cards on the video, the scrub bar and transport tooltips, the clip in / out toasts and the timeline strip under the player. {time}, {t0}, {t1}, {pos} and similar are timecodes such as 1:02:03 or 0:56.50. "In" and "out" are the clip's start and end points, as in a video editor. A proxy is a smaller copy of the whole recording made for scrubbing.
@title.rendering: {kind} is an event type such as Kill; {height} is a number of video lines (720 for 720p).
@tip.rendered_enc: {encoder} is an encoder name: x264 or NVENC.
err.play_clip: This clip could not be played.
err.play_proxy: The proxy could not be played.
pick.title: Pick an event
pick.text: Choose one in Events (or press N): its clip plays here from the pre-roll.
pick.more: Or click the timeline below to look at any moment of this recording.
pick.short: Choose one in Events (or press N), or click the timeline below.
proxy.card_title: No proxy for this recording yet
proxy.card_text: A {height}p proxy is a copy of the whole {duration} file for scrubbing it from end to end (it is made several times faster than real time).
@proxy.progress: {message} is the job's own progress text, {percent} a percentage such as 42%.
proxy.all_tip: Queue proxies for every recording with events

proxy.all_toast.one: queued {count} proxy ({candidates} recordings with events lack one)
proxy.all_toast.other: queued {count} proxies ({candidates} recordings with events lack one)

mode.full_tip: The whole recording, played from its proxy
mode.full_noproxy_tip: The whole recording: no proxy yet (build one from here)
bound.wait: wait for this event's clip to load
bound.reset: clip back to the pre-roll / post-roll
evt.title: {kind} {time}
@tl.tip: {score} is a detection confidence between 0 and 1.
tl.no_proxy_tip: Full recording mode needs a proxy (build it from the player)
@tl.kind.kill: Event counts on the line above the timeline, e.g. "3 kills".
@tl.kind_other: An event type without its own text; {kind} is its lower-case name.
